title: umap
description:
UMAP (Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection) is a manifold learning
technique for visualizing high-dimensional data. It optimizes the
low-dimensional embedding so that it best reflects the topology of the data,
as represented by a precomputed neighborhood graph (e.g. from the
`find_neighbors` component). See McInnes et al. (2018), arXiv:1802.03426.

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

uns_neighbors.description: The `.uns` neighbors slot as output by the `find_neighbors` component.

obsm_output.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting UMAP embedding.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata
objects

min_dist.description: The effective minimum distance between embedded points

spread.description: The effective scale of embedded points

num_components.description: The number of dimensions of the embedding.

max_iter.description: The number of iterations (epochs) of the optimization

alpha.description: The initial learning rate for the embedding optimization.

negative_sample_rate.description:
The number of negative edge/1-simplex samples to use per positive
edge/1-simplex sample in optimizing the low dimensional embedding.

init_pos.description: How to initialize the low dimensional embedding

random_state.description: Seed used by the random number generator.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
